mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 1% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, the labor market's dual indicators signal economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 110 signals increased industrial production, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of tightening cycle instances with INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS by more than 5% month-over-month indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 3%, the combination signals monetary policy ineffectiveness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: An UNRATE increase of more than 0.5% in two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 900,000 indicates reduced housing demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only in early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this regime-conditional signal remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
